headlines.summary: 국토부, 매물잠김 해소조치 매수자는 무주택자로 제한 정부가 토지거래허가구역(토허구역)에서 주택 매수자에게 적용되는 실거주 의무를 세입자가 있는 모든 주택을 대상으로 연말까지 한시 유예한다. 다만 매수자가 무주택자인 경우로 제한된다. 지난 9일 다주택자 양도소득세 중과 유예조치 종료 후 시장에서 매물 잠김 현상이 발생하자 이를 해소하려는 조치로 해석된다.

headlines.title: 비거주 1주택자도 전 세 낀 매도 허용…"양도세 따져봐야"
headlines.summary: ▲ 서울 송파구 롯데월드타워에서 바라본 강남3구 아파트 모습. 이재명 대통령이 다주택자는 물론 비거주 1주택자가 보유한 주택에 대해서도 5월 9일까지 토지거래 허가를 신청할 경우 전월세를 끼고 집을 팔 수 있도록 허용하겠다고 밝히면서 최근 감소 추세로 돌아선 서울의 주택 매물이 다시 증가하는 모습을 보입니다.

headlines.title: 오늘부터 비거주 1주택 ‘ 세 낀 매물 ’도 매도 허용
headlines.summary: 정부 연말까지 토허구역 내 ‘세 낀 매물’ 매도 허용 매수자 무주택자 한정, 최대 2년 실거주 유예 적용 최근 서울 강남구 압구정동의 한 부동산에 급매물 가격표가 부착되어 있다. 임세준 기자 [헤럴드경제=홍승희 기자] 오늘부터 토지거래허가구역 내 1주택자가 임대 중인 주택도 매매거래를 할 수 있게 됐다.

핵심이슈.summary:
## 오늘의 한국 경제 흐름 요약

오늘 글로벌 금융시장은 긴축 장기화 우려와 정치적 불확실성이 맞물리며 전반적으로 긴장감이 높아졌다. 채권시장에서는 비둘기파적 기대를 압도하는 강경 긴축 신호가 우세한 가운데, 영국에서는 총리 거취 논란이 겹치며 국채 금리가 일제히 급등해 재정 불안 우려를 키웠다. 외환시장에서는 구두 개입 등 위협적 신호들이 실제 시장 흐름을 바꾸지 못하는 '공허한 위협'에 그치고 있다는 분석이 제기됐다. 한편 국내에서는 대형 증권사들의 신용융자 한도가 잇따라 소진되자 투자자들이 CFD(차액결제거래) 등 우회 수단으로 몰리며 레버리지 과열 조짐이 나타나고 있어 주의가 필요하다. 여기에 KDI는 고유가가 장기화될 경우 올해 소비자물가를 최대 1.6%p 끌어올릴 수 있다고 경고했으며, '빅쇼트'의 마이클 버리도 현재 증시가 1999년 닷컴버블 말기와 유사하다고 진단해 인플레이션 재점화와 자산시장 버블 붕괴에 대한 경계심이 동시에 고조되고 있다.

top5_headlines.summary: 보유공제 축소·폐지시 최대 2.5배 증가 서울 용산 등 고가주택 최대 5억원대 세금 稅 부담에 매물 위축 우려, “출회 제한적” 정부가 거주 중심으로 장기보유특별공제(장특공제)를 제도를 개편할 경우, 비거주 1주택자의 양도소득세 부담이 최소 2배 이상 늘어날 것으로 전망된다.

top5_headlines.title: 韓증시 시총, 대만 꺾고 6위 … 1분기 성장률 ‘ 1 .694%’ 주요국 1위
top5_headlines.summary: 코스피·코스닥 합쳐 6876조원 올해 성장률 전망도 잇단 상향 한국 증시가 반도체 슈퍼 사이클 흐름을 타고 상승세를 이어가면서 시가총액에서 이번에는 대만까지 제치고 세계 6위에 올라섰다. 올 1분기 한국의 실질 국내총생산(GDP) 성장률도 세계 22개 주요국 중 가장 높은 것으로 나타나는 등 상승세에 힘을 보태고 있다.

top5_headlines.title: 실거주 유예, 연말까지 ‘ 세입자 있는 모든 주택 ’ 확대 적용
top5_headlines.summary: 국토부, 매물잠김 해소조치 매수자는 무주택자로 제한 정부가 토지거래허가구역(토허구역)에서 주택 매수자에게 적용되는 실거주 의무를 세입자가 있는 모든 주택을 대상으로 연말까지 한시 유예한다. 다만 매수자가 무주택자인 경우로 제한된다. 지난 9일 다주택자 양도소득세 중과 유예조치 종료 후 시장에서 매물 잠김 현상이 발생하자 이를 해소하려는 조치로 해석된다.

top5_headlines.title: “ 팔면 다시 못 산다 ”… 시장 “ 이젠 보유나 증여, 아니면 갈아타기죠 ”
top5_headlines.summary: 비거주1주택 ‘세 낀 매물’ 허용효과 미지수 “집값 더 오른다”, 송파·용산·성동 ‘버티기’ 매물 한달새 16% 감소, 호가 ‘신고가’ 수준 “비거주 1주택 매물, 갈아타기 목적 대다수” “임대차 시장 혼란, 결국 임차인 손해볼 것” 서울 용산구 용산역 인근 아파트 단지 모습.

key_headlines.title: UK Government Bonds Surge Amid Political Uncertainty
key_headlines.summary: British gilt yields jumped sharply, with 10-year bonds rising 8 basis points, as political pressure mounts on the UK Prime Minister. Market volatility reflects concerns over fiscal policy and economic stability.

key_headlines.title: KOSPI Approaches 8000 Mark Amid Semiconductor Boom
key_headlines.summary: South Korea's stock market hit nearly 8000 points driven by semiconductor strength and AI investment expectations, though rate hikes, oil prices, and inflation data pose downside risks.

key_headlines.title: 'Big Short' Investor Warns of 1999 Dot-com Bubble Parallels
key_headlines.summary: Renowned short-seller Barry highlighted similarities between current market conditions and the final stages of the 1999 dot-com bubble, raising concerns about valuation sustainability.

key_headlines.title: Q1 GDP Growth Leads Global Peers at 1.694%
key_headlines.summary: South Korea recorded the highest first-quarter real GDP growth rate among 22 countries that released data, at 1.694% quarter-over-quarter, signaling economic resilience.

key_headlines.title: Large Corporations Shift to CFD Trading as Leverage Options Tighten
key_headlines.summary: Following credit limit restrictions, major companies including Kyobo Life are increasingly turning to CFD (Contract for Difference) trading as alternatives for leveraged investments tighten.

sections.Hot Economy News: South Korea's economy is showing mixed signals as semiconductor exports drive growth while inflation pressures persist. The country recorded Q1 GDP growth of 1.694%, the highest among tracked nations, driven primarily by semiconductor sector strength fueled by AI investment expansion. However, Middle East conflict-related oil price increases are raising consumer inflation to 2.6%, and inflation expectations are rising, creating policy dilemmas for the central bank. The KDI noted that semiconductor exports are spearheading economic recovery, but external uncertainties from geopolitical tensions continue to threaten capital investment in non-semiconductor sectors.
sections.Macro & Fiscal Policy: The Bank of Korea faces an increasingly complex policy environment as it balances price stability with economic growth objectives. New monetary policy committee member Professor Kim Jin-il emphasized the need for optimal policy coordination between the central bank and government, acknowledging concerns about post-Middle East conflict inflation. The government's fiscal and monetary authorities are struggling with conflicting mandates: rate hikes could dampen the stock market and domestic demand, while rate cuts could exacerbate inflation and currency pressures. April consumer inflation expanded to 2.6% as transport disruptions increased production costs, while expected inflation is also rising.
sections.Financial Markets: The KOSPI surged to nearly 8000 points during trading, with semiconductor stocks Samsung Electronics and SK Hynix leading gains amid global AI investment momentum. Multiple global investment banks have raised Korean market outlooks, though analysts caution that upcoming U.S. inflation data (CPI), interest rate decisions, and Middle East oil price volatility could trigger sharp corrections. The 'bond king' scenario is shifting with potential rate increases on the horizon if energy prices push inflation above 3.5%, contradicting current Fed guidance. Large corporations are increasingly turning to CFD trading as credit limits tighten, indicating elevated leverage risk in financial markets.
sections.Industry & Technology: South Korea's pharmaceutical and biotech sectors delivered strong Q1 performance driven by export growth, with major players like Samsung Biologics and Celltrion achieving record earnings. The semiconductor industry continues to benefit from AI data center demand, with SK Hynix receiving upgraded price targets due to DRAM and enterprise SSD demand surge expectations. However, Japanese automakers are struggling with the electric vehicle 'chasm' (demand cliff), potentially creating opportunities for Korean battery manufacturers, though near-term order flow concerns exist. Cryptocurrency investments among elderly investors (60+) are rising significantly, with 70+ cohort showing 5.8% growth year-over-year as mobile trading accessibility increases.
sections.Real Estate: Apartment supply sentiment improved significantly with the May supply forecast index rising 19.1 points to 80.0, driven by rising jeonse (long-term lease) prices stimulating buyer interest. Jeonse prices are rising faster than sale prices (2.20% vs 1.79% in metropolitan areas), creating affordability concerns and shifting tenant insecurity. Government regulations restricting multi-property owners and reduced new construction are tightening rental inventory, with Seoul apartment listings declining sharply and expected further pressure on tenants as landlords raise jeonse prices. Illegal jeonse contract fraud has surfaced as rising property values create higher stakes for unlawful transactions.
sections.International Economy: The U.S. Federal Reserve faces pressure to hold rates steady despite inflation concerns, with markets pricing in minimal rate cuts through 2026 and potential hikes if energy prices persist. Fed Chair Powell has reaffirmed central bank independence from political pressure ahead of his term conclusion, while successor leadership faces economic uncertainty. Bank of America predicts no Fed rate cuts in 2026, with cuts possibly beginning in July 2027 if labor market weakening continues. The FOMC has recorded its highest dissent rate since 1992, with 4 votes against the latest decision, reflecting internal policy divisions amid conflicting economic signals.
sections.AI & Economy: AI technology is creating both job displacement and creation dynamics, with the concept of 'creative destruction' explaining how innovation drives growth through workforce transformation. SK Hynix received upgraded price targets with 280 million won goals as KB Securities highlighted early-stage AI market expansion, projecting long-term memory price increases and server DRAM demand surge. Microsoft's internal documents revealed expected 92 billion dollar returns from OpenAI investments, demonstrating the massive capital commitments flowing into AI infrastructure. The government is proposing 'national dividend' redistribution mechanisms to ensure AI-era prosperity benefits broader society rather than concentrating gains among select corporations.
sections.Others: The government is strengthening AI-powered fraud detection systems for national subsidy distribution, upgrading from pattern-matching to autonomous learning systems that identify suspicious money flows. Korea Electric Power Company achieved 12 consecutive years of inclusion in the Dow Jones Best-in-Class Asia-Pacific ESG index, recognized as the sole state-owned enterprise receiving this distinction. University employment support programs are incorporating generative AI to enhance job placement outcomes through interview preparation and personal branding assistance. Policy officials are advocating for wealth redistribution mechanisms in the AI era, proposing 'national dividend' policies to prevent concentration of gains among specific companies and sectors.
